body.purpose: Inherited native desktop control and body type.

motion.name: drawer-enter
motion.purpose: Clip reveal and translateX(12px) to zero only when prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Shared search and wordmark
components.description: Native wordmark and broad search; white Dig, amber Up, neutral icon, amber focus border.
components.html: DigUp
components.css: .ds-search-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;padding:12px 20px;background:var(--surface,#202429);color:var(--text,#eef2f6);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif}.ds-wordmark{flex:none;width:140px;font-size:25px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.025em}.ds-up{color:var(--amber,#f0a048)}.ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex:1;min-width:0;height:40px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid #46515c;border-radius:8px;background:#252b32}.ds-search:focus-within{border-color:var(--amber,#f0a048)}.ds-search svg{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none;fill:none;stroke:var(--secondary,#b4bec8);stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round}.ds-search input{width:100%;min-width:0;padding:0;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text,#eef2f6);font:15px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;caret-color:var(--amber,#f0a048)}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--secondary,#b4bec8)}@media(max-width:1100px){.ds-wordmark{width:auto;font-size:22px}.ds-search-header{gap:16px}}@media(max-width:800px){.ds-wordmark{font-size:20px}.ds-search-header{padding:10px 12px;gap:12px}}

components.name: Workspace navigation
components.description: Separate Search, Graph, and People destinations, active icon and underline; neutral hover fill.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Workspace"><button type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="6.5"/><path d="m15 15 6 6"/></svg>Search</button><button type="button" disabled>Graph</button><button type="button" aria-current="page"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M4 22V19A8 8 0 0 1 20 19V22"/></svg>People</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:8px;height:48px;padding:0 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#3b434c);background:var(--surface,#202429)}.ds-nav button{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 16px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--secondary,#b4bec8);font:13px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}.ds-nav button[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--text,#eef2f6);font-weight:600}.ds-nav button[aria-current="page"]::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:0;left:12px;right:12px;height:3px;background:var(--amber,#f0a048);border-radius:3px 3px 0 0}.ds-nav svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-nav button[aria-current="page"] svg{color:var(--amber,#f0a048)}.ds-nav button:hover{color:var(--text,#eef2f6);background:#2b323a}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--amber,#f0a048);outline-offset:2px}.ds-nav button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}@media(max-width:800px){.ds-nav{padding:0 8px;gap:0}.ds-nav button{padding:0 10px;gap:6px}}

components.name: People and Faces quiet action
components.description: Compact native action used by Refresh, Rename, and Faces review controls.
components.css: .ds-quiet{font:13px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;padding:6px 10px;color:#e1e7ee;background:#323940;border:1px solid #505962;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}.ds-quiet:hover:not(:disabled){background:#424c57}.ds-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--amber,#f0a048);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-quiet:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default}

components.name: Active review tab
components.description: Amber selection with dark ink; hover brightens the fill while preserving the active state.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:0 20px 12px;background:var(--surface,#202429);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#3b434c)}.ds-tabs button{font:13px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;color:var(--secondary,#b4bec8);background:transparent;cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#424c57}.ds-tabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:#211b12;background:var(--amber,#f0a048);border-color:var(--amber,#f0a048);font-weight:600}.ds-tabs button[aria-pressed="true"]:hover:not(:disabled){background:#f6b466;border-color:#f6b466;color:#211b12}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--amber,#f0a048);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-tabs button:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default}

components.name: Media filter chip
components.description: Media filters are compact rectangular buttons in the gallery count/sort row.
components.css: .ds-media{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--surface,#202429)}.ds-media button{font:13px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #505962;border-radius:8px;background:#323940;color:#e1e7ee;cursor:pointer}.ds-media button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#424c57}.ds-media button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:#211b12;background:var(--amber,#f0a048);border-color:var(--amber,#f0a048);font-weight:600}.ds-media button[aria-pressed="true"]:hover:not(:disabled){background:#f6b466;border-color:#f6b466;color:#211b12}.ds-media button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--amber,#f0a048);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-media button:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default}

components.name: Selected local label
components.description: Warm current-person row; the live app replaces the SVG with the current real crop when available.
components.css: .ds-person{display:flex;width:100%;gap:9px;align-items:center;text-align:left;padding:10px 8px;border:1px solid #8d673a;border-radius:8px;background:#453725;color:#eef2f6;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-person svg{width:24px;height:24px;flex:none;fill:none;stroke:#b4bec8;stroke-width:1.4}.ds-person>span{display:grid;min-width:0;gap:4px}.ds-person strong{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-person small{font-size:11px;color:#b4bec8}.ds-person:hover:not(:disabled){background:#424c57}.ds-person:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--amber,#f0a048);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-person:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default}

components.name: Inclusive year endpoints
components.description: Precise inclusive From/Through inputs and two native range handles; the live app derives extent and fill from the actual album.
components.html: Capture date when available; otherwise file modification date.
components.css: .ds-period{padding:12px 20px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#3b434c);background:var(--surface,#202429);color:var(--text,#eef2f6);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif}.ds-period-fields{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}.ds-period-fields label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:12px;color:var(--secondary,#b4bec8)}.ds-period-fields input{width:78px;padding:6px 8px;font:inherit;color:var(--text,#eef2f6);background:#252b32;border:1px solid #505962;border-radius:6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;accent-color:var(--amber,#f0a048)}.ds-period-fields input[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:#e3a5a1}.ds-period-fields input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--amber,#f0a048);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-rail{position:relative;height:30px;margin-top:8px}.ds-rail>span{position:absolute;top:15px;left:8px;right:8px;height:2px;background:#687785}.ds-rail>span::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;height:2px;background:var(--amber,#f0a048)}.ds-rail input{position:absolute;width:100%;margin:0;top:4px;height:24px;background:transparent;appearance:none;pointer-events:none}.ds-rail input::-webkit-slider-thumb{appearance:none;background:var(--amber,#f0a048);width:14px;height:14px;border:2px solid #202429;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:auto;cursor:ew-resize}.ds-rail input::-moz-range-thumb{background:var(--amber,#f0a048);width:12px;height:12px;border:2px solid #202429;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:auto;cursor:ew-resize}.ds-rail input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--amber,#f0a048);outline-offset:1px;border-radius:4px}.ds-period-help{margin:8px 0 0;font-size:11px;color:var(--secondary,#b4bec8)}@media(forced-colors:active){.ds-rail>span,.ds-rail>span::after{background:CanvasText}}

components.name: Photo-led album cell
components.description: Neutral 4:3 mat for a whole local image, filename, date, and visible fallback-date source. The snippet intentionally has no invented photograph.

components.name: Compact background status
components.description: One compact background-task footer; details and full automatic-face status are available on demand.
components.css: .ds-status{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:34px;padding:0 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#3b434c);background:var(--surface,#202429);color:var(--text,#eef2f6);font:11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-status button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0;height:100%;padding:0 5px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--secondary,#b4bec8);font:inherit;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}.ds-status .ds-status-details{margin-left:auto;flex:none}.ds-status-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#a4aeba;flex:none}.ds-status button:hover{background:#2b323a;color:var(--text,#eef2f6)}.ds-status button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--amber,#f0a048);outline-offset:2px}@media(max-width:800px){.ds-status{padding:0 8px;gap:6px}}@media(forced-colors:active){.ds-status-dot{background:CanvasText}}

components.description: Graph-specific warm selected plate. Preserve actual media icons/thumbnails and measured text in the live SVG scene.

narrative.overview:
DigUp's Windows/Linux Tauri HTML shell uses a shared dark graphite world for Search, Graph, People, and contextual face investigation. Restrained warm amber identifies current actions and selections; quiet native sans text, fine separators, and spacious working areas keep local files and photographs primary. This records the user-approved expansion of the earlier graph system. The separate native macOS application has its own implementation.

People is a photo-led library: choose a local label, choose an inclusive year interval, then browse whole media. A slim two-handle rail and precise fields give the period a useful visual signature. One compact background-task footer keeps work visible; index details, language, and automatic-face settings open in a drawer. Actual local crops, filenames, dates, and counts supply the content.

Graph retains its established glass file plates, world grid, modality cues, and evidence review colors. Faces retains source-led media, numbered detections, real crops, and separate candidate review. These established evidence materials coexist with the flatter shared chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Shared graphite search header, three main destinations, and contextual face action.
Warm current-person selection, neutral counts, and uncropped album photographs.
Two inclusive year endpoints, native range handles, and explicit date provenance.
One compact background-task footer with on-demand detail and settings.
Graph evidence colors and independent preview/bulk-selection states.
Native sans, authored SVG icons, RU/EN copy, keyboard focus, and desktop reflow.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Amber follows current shell and People actions and the selected graph/source observation. Cyan keeps its scoped video, face-box, and inspected-candidate meanings. Graph review colors retain their explicit text and line-pattern evidence.

rules.name: The Separate Selection Rule
rules.body: A candidate or observation highlight chooses a preview. A native checkbox chooses observations for label actions. Preview selection never implies a checked observation or confirmed identity.

rules.name: The Content Type Rule
rules.body: Keep names, paths, counts, dates, and scores readable through wrapping, appropriate truncation, and accessible context; preserve the native type hierarchy rather than shrinking content to fit.

rules.name: The Topology Rule
rules.body: Graph force positions communicate connections, not measured similarity distance. Graph timeline positions encode modification dates except for explicit pins. Keep the (120-file) cap and actual expansion scope visible.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Shared chrome and album cells remain flat. Graph's existing plate depth and selection/video glow serve its evidence scene; they are scoped materials rather than a reason to decorate every control.

dos: **Do** use the shared graphite shell for Search, Graph, People, and contextual Faces on Windows/Linux.
**Do** retain the white Dig / amber Up wordmark and restrained amber active states.
**Do** keep photographs whole, dates explicit, counts neutral, and year endpoints inclusive.
**Do** keep media filters, gallery count, and sort together in one wrapping control row.
**Do** keep background detail in the drawer and local-label explanations in the information affordance.
**Do** preserve graph evidence colors, world grid, glass plates, actual scores, and line-pattern review cues.
**Do** keep preview highlights separate from checked bulk selections and unconfirmed suggestions.
**Do** preserve RU/EN text, native keyboard operation, focus recovery, reduced motion, and implemented forced-colors behavior.
donts: **Don't** substitute mock portraits, names, counts, years, or metadata for actual local content.
**Don't** crop album photographs into face thumbnails or hide file-date fallback provenance behind hover alone.
**Don't** add persistent success/explanation bands above the album or restore a second background-status strip.
**Don't** extend a graph-specific evidence color into a new global meaning without an explicit product decision.
**Don't** present local labels, cosine, or matching capture dates as proof of identity or provenance.
**Don't** turn desktop reflow targets into mobile support or claim a fidelity/release check that has not passed.
